description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericAbstractDispatcher' that provides a foundational implementation for a service dispatcher in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles scheduling of services, transaction management, and registration of rollback and commit services, serving as a base class for concrete dispatcher implementations.

classes.name: GenericAbstractDispatcher
classes.description: An abstract class implementing core dispatcher functionality such as service scheduling, transaction management, and callback registration within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: initDispatchContext
methods.description: Initializes and registers the dispatch context, handling class loader setup and optional debug logging.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specified future time with given parameters, managing transactions and job management.

methods.name: addRollbackService
methods.description: Registers a rollback service to be invoked in case of transaction rollback.

methods.name: addCommitService
methods.description: Registers a commit service to be invoked upon transaction commit.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator instance used by the dispatcher.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security instance used by the dispatcher.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dispatcher.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Deregisters the dispatcher, removing it from cache and deregistering from the parent dispatcher.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific service.
